g.text: P1_5V = Nordic V5V (USB 5V or battery Vin)

g.desc: P1_5V = Nordic V5V (USB 5V or battery Vin)

g.text: PON = 0V: Enabled (~68 uA) | PON = 3.3V: Disabled (0.0 uA)

g.desc: PON = 0V: Enabled (~68 uA) | PON = 3.3V: Disabled (0.0 uA)

g.text: MEASURE OUT HIGH LEVEL BEFORE CONNECTING DK P0.25!

g.desc: MEASURE OUT HIGH LEVEL BEFORE CONNECTING DK P0.25!

g.text: 1. POWER MODES: (A) USB bring-up: 3V3 from P1 VDD only; do NOT attach battery to P1 5V. (B) Battery demo: USB unplugged; Akyga→plain LiPo Amigo BAT/VBAT→MSS-2245 (SW5)→P1 5V + buzzer+. Amigo 5V pads = USB VBUS only (no SYS/DEVICE jack on PIM611). NEVER dual-feed USB+battery.

g.desc: 1. POWER MODES: (A) USB bring-up: 3V3 from P1 VDD only; do NOT attach battery to P1 5V. (B) Battery demo: USB unplugged; Akyga→plain LiPo Amigo BAT/VBAT→MSS-2245 (SW5)→P1 5V + buzzer+. Amigo 5V pads = USB VBUS only (no SYS/DEVICE jack on PIM611). NEVER dual-feed USB+battery.

g.text: Verify BS1 = 0 (4-wire SPI) on HAT rear switch

g.desc: Verify BS1 = 0 (4-wire SPI) on HAT rear switch

g.text: 3. DCF-77 VERIFICATION: Measure DCF OUT high-level voltage before connecting to DK P0.25. Orient antenna perpendicular to Frankfurt.

g.desc: 3. DCF-77 VERIFICATION: Measure DCF OUT high-level voltage before connecting to DK P0.25. Orient antenna perpendicular to Frankfurt.

g.text: 2. SAFE CONTROL STATES: Set DCF_PON HIGH (disabled, 0.0uA). Set EPD_CS and SENSOR_CS HIGH (unselected). Set BUZZER_EN LOW (off).

g.desc: 2. SAFE CONTROL STATES: Set DCF_PON HIGH (disabled, 0.0uA). Set EPD_CS and SENSOR_CS HIGH (unselected). Set BUZZER_EN LOW (off).

g.text: 7. BATTERY PATH: plain LiPo Amigo (PIM611) is the off-board charger; Akyga cell on its JST. Amigo BAT/VBAT + GND go to shield J5. SW5 = MSS-2245 (DPDT part, one pole drawn as SPDT) in series VBAT→5V (=VBAT_SW→DK P1_5V + BZ1). Leave Fast Charge pads open.

g.desc: 7. BATTERY PATH: plain LiPo Amigo (PIM611) is the off-board charger; Akyga cell on its JST. Amigo BAT/VBAT + GND go to shield J5. SW5 = MSS-2245 (DPDT part, one pole drawn as SPDT) in series VBAT→5V (=VBAT_SW→DK P1_5V + BZ1). Leave Fast Charge pads open.

g.text: 6. STAGED BRING-UP: 1) DK Blinky -> 2) E-Paper Demo -> 3) LIS3DH WHO_AM_I -> 4) DCF Standalone -> 5) DCF Sync -> 6) Buzzer Alarm.

g.desc: 6. STAGED BRING-UP: 1) DK Blinky -> 2) E-Paper Demo -> 3) LIS3DH WHO_AM_I -> 4) DCF Standalone -> 5) DCF Sync -> 6) Buzzer Alarm.

g.text: 5. BUZZER DRIVER: Verify 2N3904 TO-92 pinout (E-B-C). Buzzer+ and D1 cathode on 5V/VBAT_SW — NOT 3V3 (buzzer is silent on 3V3).

g.desc: 5. BUZZER DRIVER: Verify 2N3904 TO-92 pinout (E-B-C). Buzzer+ and D1 cathode on 5V/VBAT_SW — NOT 3V3 (buzzer is silent on 3V3).

g.text: 4. E-PAPER CONFIGURATION: Verify switch BS1 = 0 on back of Waveshare HAT for 4-wire SPI mode before powering display rail.

g.desc: 4. E-PAPER CONFIGURATION: Verify switch BS1 = 0 on back of Waveshare HAT for 4-wire SPI mode before powering display rail.

g.text: Prefer switch OFF while charging (USB-C on Amigo only). Never use Amigo 5V pads as battery rail.

g.desc: Prefer switch OFF while charging (USB-C on Amigo only). Never use Amigo 5V pads as battery rail.

g.text: BLOCK 6: BATTERY IN (plain LiPo Amigo PIM611 off-board)

g.desc: BLOCK 6: BATTERY IN (plain LiPo Amigo PIM611 off-board)

g.text: Amigo BAT/VBAT → J5; SW5 MSS-2245 one pole (common→5V, throw→VBAT); other throw NC=OFF. No DEVICE/SYS jack.

g.desc: Amigo BAT/VBAT → J5; SW5 MSS-2245 one pole (common→5V, throw→VBAT); other throw NC=OFF. No DEVICE/SYS jack.
